2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Industrial Epc works for National Expressway Development Authority completed 2014.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included a high water table requiring continuous
dewatering. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the department for
additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of delayed handover of the site
frontage by the local authority. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the
agency's control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the
approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been
completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending
Engineer.
3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Very Good. Workmanship was good, with
finishing standards above the specified norm, and final inspection was completed in the presence of
the client's representative. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test results filed with
this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, minor honeycombing on one abutment face, since made good. Regarding
site safety, a safety audit was carried out mid-contract with no major non-conformity. The agency's
conduct during the contract is recorded as responsive throughout the defect liability period.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2014-07-17. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the
inspecting authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the
joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend
release of the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability
period. Certified by M. Raghavan, Chief Engineer (Works).
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and
contract conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried
out by the undersigned.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the contractor
of any obligations under the contract, including the defect liability period.
